summary.tldr: Requires consent from at least two thirds of provinces without comprehensive pension plans before a province can adopt one.
what_it_does: Requires provincial consent before regulations can be made for a province to adopt a comprehensive pension plan under the Canada Pension Plan.
Requires consent from at least two thirds of the provinces without comprehensive pension plans, and those provinces must have at least two thirds of that group’s population.
Delays the law’s start until 180 days after royal assent.
summary.background: It amends section 3 of the Canada Pension Plan. The bill comes into force 180 days after royal assent.
